name: Ancient Duel
description:
Condition:
6 tiles on the battlefield are no longer available for deployment.

abilities.text: Each time an enemy is defeated, gains ATK and ASPD, stacking up to 10 times.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
When destroyed, grants a deployable unit
Has significantly increased DEF and RES for a period of time
Significantly decreases ATK of the unit with the highest ATK for a period of time
Attacks deal Physical damage to the target and adjacent allied units
Does charged attacks, dealing heavy Physical damage to the targets and any adjacent units
Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Withered Knight> dies
Fires explosive arrows at three targets which explode after a short delay, dealing high Arts damage to the target and surrounding four tiles
Gains greatly increased ATK, ASPD, and Movement Speed when <Corrupted Knight> dies

waveSchedule.scope: No-deployment route/wave sweep with raised life only, using the compiled stage time limit; not a playable clear or fidelity approval

browserStartup.scope: Mobile landscape browser startup and canvas runtime; not a fidelity approval
